info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Account Management Fraud Evaluations-spec
info.description: The Account Management Fraud Evaluation Retrieval API provides seamless access to fraud evaluation reports related to account management. This endpoint enables authorized users to retrieve detailed insights on potential fraud cases, improving risk management and customer protection. Typical consumers include banking analysts and fraud prevention teams who need to assess account-related risks and take necessary actions. Enhance your fraud detection processes by leveraging this API for timely access to critical evaluation data.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information regarding fraud evaluations conducted for accounts. It provides insights into potential fraudulent activities, helping users make informed decisions.

requestBody.description: Request payload for evaluating fraud in account management. This should include all necessary parameters to assess the fraud risk associated with an account.

200.description: Successful retrieval of fraud evaluation data.

ListAccountManagementFraudEvaluationsReq.description: A string representation of the request body for the fraud evaluation operation.

items.description: An array of account evaluation entries.
